$comment: Electronegativity findings on src/ that were reviewed and accepted, by check and file. `count` is how many instances the review covered; one more fails the check. Checked by build/check-electronegativity.ts in CI.

findings.reason: createWindow, the only place windows are made, calls guardWebContents on every window: setWindowOpenHandler denies every new window, so a middle-click cannot open one, and will-navigate and will-redirect are prevented.
The preload is the app's own bundled script. It runs sandboxed with context isolation and exposes only the frozen window.treepeek API built from the IPC contract, never ipcRenderer or Node.
Help menu items open one of the two fixed GitHub URLs in the frozen HELP_LINKS map (src/main/menu.ts), chosen by key in main. No renderer input reaches shell.openExternal.

The finding is the CSP evaluator's general caution that script-src 'self' is risky when the origin also serves JSONP, Angular or user uploads. 'self' is app://, which serves only the bundled files in out/renderer (src/main/protocol.ts).
